title: Courier HR Senior Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt’s Courier Employment team is building something that doesn’t really exist yet — a cross-country infrastructure for employed courier operations across multiple geographies. We sit at the intersection of operations, people, legal, and compliance, and we’re doing it largely from scratch.</p> <p>The function currently spans three countries (Finland, Germany, Croatia), each at a different stage of maturity and with different legal frameworks. Courier employment is managed in all these countries by a functional team handling strategy, structure and resources, and country-level teams focused on execution and operational excellence from the ground up.</p> <p>We operate in a fast-moving environment with a high degree of uncertainty — regulatory, operational, and structural. If you’re energised by the possibilities and want to be the person who builds the playbook, this might be the right role for you.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>Croatia doesn't have an independent Courier HR operating model yet. It has support from the general employee HR team, great people working hard, manual workarounds, and a scale-up landing in the next few months that the current setup wasn't built to absorb. This role exists to establish Courier HR expertise within the function and build the processes needed while running the team's day-to-day HR operations.</p> <p>As Courier HR Senior Specialist in Croatia, you'll own the full employee lifecycle for a fast-growing courier workforce: onboarding, contracts, documentation, leave, and the HR side of a workforce that includes couriers relocating from abroad. This includes tracking of work permits and other integration and compliance related matters.&nbsp;</p> <p>You'll be supported by the function’s core team and leadership and work closely with your Courier HR Lead, the Workforce Ops team, Legal, and the sourcing agencies bringing couriers in. You'll be the most senior Courier HR operator on the ground in Croatia day-to-day — which means you'll be trusted to make independent decisions and participate actively in building foundations and standards that will apply across all markets.</p> <h2>What you'll be doing</h2> <p><strong>Employee lifecycle execution at scale</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own onboarding, contracts, documentation, and leave administration for Croatia's employed couriers, including the operational HR side of relocating couriers from abroad (documentation, work permit tracking, compliance).</li> <li>Delegating and syncing with a Tier 1 HR team that handles standard inbound tickets and manual entry.</li> <li>Build and maintain accurate employee records across HR systems as the courier base scales.</li> <li>Handle the volume and pace of onboarding waves without letting quality or compliance slip.</li> <li>Make the judgment calls on ambiguous or non-standard cases that come up, escalating appropriately to your Courier HR Lead or Legal.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process and SOP creation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Create SOPs, checklists, and documentation in collaboration with the functional Process &amp; Systems Senior Specialist based on cross-market standards and calibrated to local requirements.</li> <li>Identify where the current setup will break under the incoming scale-up, then plan and build for it before it breaks.</li> <li>Partner with the Process &amp; Systems Senior Specialist on anything that should become a cross-country standard rather than a local fix.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional coordination</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the day-to-day HR point of contact for the sourcing agencies bringing couriers into Croatia, ensuring HR-side obligations (documentation, onboarding timing, permits) are met on time.</li> <li>Work with Workforce Ops to keep HR and operational onboarding in sync as waves of new couriers arrive.</li> <li>Flag structural risks early and initiate appropriate action in collaboration with your Lead and functional colleagues.</li> </ul> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <p>There’s no single background that defines this role — but the people who do well here tend to combine sharp analytical thinking with genuine operational curiosity. Some things that matter:</p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in HR operations, people operations, or workforce administration — ideally somewhere that involved real scale, strict deadlines, or a workforce with cross-border or compliance complexity.</li> <li>Experience working with foreign worker documentation, work permits, residence permits, or employment compliance processes.</li> <li>A genuine ability to operate without a finished playbook. If "there's no process for this yet" makes you anxious rather than interested, this isn't the right role.</li> <li>High attention to detail that holds up under volume and pressure — the documentation has legal weight, and the standard shouldn’t drop with rapidly increasing volume.</li> <li>Good judgment about what to decide yourself and what to escalate. This role only works if you can be trusted with ambiguity — and trusted to know your own limits within it.</li> <li>Fluency in Croatian (C1-C2) and professional level in English (B2-C2) are a requirement. Given the courier population arriving from abroad, comfort working through language and documentation barriers is a real asset — additional languages (Spanish, for instance) are a plus but not requirement.</li> <li>Ability to work in a hybrid model from our Zagreb office (4 office days, Wednesday optional work-from-home day).</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <p>Most HR operations roles ask you to run a process well. This one asks you to build the process while running it, for a workforce that's about to grow faster than the current setup was designed for, in a market where the team is small and knowledge is yet to be mapped to documentation. You will work with a team of experts in multiple countries, giving you a unique chance to influence our strategies, standards and ways of working while constantly learning something new.</p> <p>If it sounds like the kind of challenge you would enjoy solving, and if you are inspired by the potential of directly impacting the experience of hard working individuals establishing themselves in a new country, this will be a great opportunity for you.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Please note that this is a fixed-term contract until Dec 31st 2026, with a possibility to extend to a permanent contract. We’re expecting you to be able to start working with us during August-early September.</strong></p> <p><strong>Additional benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Health insurance</li> <li>A sport benefit (PassSport)</li> <li>A tax-free commuter benefit</li> <li>A monthly lunch benefit</li> <li>Wolt Credits Cashback program</li> <li>Access to the Employee Assistance Program (free, confidential mental health support) and the Cuckoo wellness app</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <p><strong>Please submit your application and resume in English.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The hiring process includes conversations with the talent acquisition partner, hiring managers and a practical assignment with a final cross-functional discussion.</p> <p>If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of a motivated team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About selectry
selectry is a Berlin-based HR-tech company building a skill-based alternative to traditional job-board recruiting. Instead of recycling generic job postings, we work directly with hiring companies to understand what a role really requires, then match candidates on demonstrated skills and mindset rather than job titles, degrees, or CV pedigree. Our process combines structured, AI-supported matching with a human review at every step, so no decision about a candidate is ever made by an algorithm alone. We are in active build phase: a small, cross-functional team that moves fast, owns problems end to end, and works fully remote across Germany. If you have worked in an early-stage or startup environment before, the pace and the level of ownership will feel familiar.

Your Role
You keep Sales and Operations running cleanly behind the scenes, so the team can focus on clients and candidates instead of chasing down data. This is an operational role built on concrete, recurring tasks: CRM administration, pipeline tracking, market research, and digital information management. A large part of it is detail-oriented upkeep, keeping records accurate, flagging gaps, and organising shared documents. If you prefer project work over structured maintenance, this is probably not the right fit. If you find satisfaction in clean systems and reliable data, you will feel at home. Because the team is small, your work is visible and your input reaches the people who act on it.

Your Responsibilities

  • Maintain and structure contact, company, and deal records in our CRM, and own the data quality

  • Track and update deal stages across the B2B pipeline, flagging gaps and keeping records current

  • Gather and prepare market and competitor research that supports commercial decisions

  • Organise operational documents, team communication, and knowledge in Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams)

  • Onboard yourself into new digital tools and help spot where recurring manual work can be simplified


Your Profile
Required:

  • Some practical experience with any CRM tool, including updating and organising records

  • Comfortable working in Microsoft 365, specifically SharePoint and Teams

  • Able to manage your own tasks reliably without daily check-ins

  • English at a professional level, written and spoken

Good to have:

  • Experience with Pipedrive specifically

  • Familiarity with automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or Power Automate

  • Prior work at a startup or early-stage company

  • A background in HR-tech, B2B SaaS, or a recruiting context

  • German language skills

A note on mindset: selectry explicitly values openness, willingness to learn, and engagement over a finished skill set. If you bring the right attitude and at least one prior role where you took real operational ownership, we want to hear from you

What We Offer 

  • Direct insight into Sales, Recruiting, and prospectively Marketing — across all three functions from day one 

  • Close collaboration with and visibility to management — short decision paths, real ownership, no bureaucracy 

  • A fully remote position within Germany — work from wherever you study 

How to Apply 

No formal cover letter required — a short note on why this role fits your current situation is enough.

raw.title: Senior Recruiter (f/m/d) Remote Germany
raw.description:
The role in brief

You will join selectry as a Senior Recruiter and run end-to-end searches through our Hiring Engine for our clients. You own the process from structured intake to signed offer, use data to improve it, and build the sourcing infrastructure that makes the next search faster than the one before.

Why this role exists

selectry is a Berlin-based hr-tech company. We build and operate the Hiring Engine for plannable recruiting. Our three product lines cover different levels of recruiting ownership for our clients. What they share is a common requirement: searches need to be run well, documented clearly, and improved continuously.

We are a small, senior team. Decisions move quickly. The work is concrete. We run our own searches and source proactively rather than relying on inbound volume. We source, assess, and advise, and we document every step.

This role exists because the Hiring Engine needs an experienced recruiter who can carry searches independently, consult clients and hiring managers with evidence and clarity, and help build the sourcing and process infrastructure that makes selectry's output reliable and repeatable.

What you will work on

  • Own the full recruiting lifecycle across client searches, from intake and role clarification through active sourcing, structured assessment, and offer management to signed contract

  • Design and run multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, XING, and direct outreach, including complex Boolean search and talent mapping for specialist and leadership profiles

  • Build and maintain talent pools of passive candidates across the segments selectry searches most frequently, structured, auditable, and ready for the next search

  • Conduct structured, competency-based interviews and advise hiring managers on evaluation criteria, profile fit, and decision quality

  • Track, analyse, and report on recruiting KPIs, including time-to-hire, time-to-fill, funnel conversion, and source-of-hire, and use the data to improve the process at every stage

  • Create and maintain search briefs, outreach templates, and interview guides within selectry's documentation infrastructure

  • Lead employer branding projects for selectry itself, for example career page content, candidate experience improvements, and outreach standards


Must-haves

  • Strong experience in recruiting, with end-to-end ownership of complex, specialist, or leadership hiring processes from sourcing through to offer

  • Hands-on active sourcing experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and multi-channel direct outreach, including the ability to design Boolean search strategies and talent maps independently

  • Experience building and maintaining structured talent pools for passive candidate segments using a CRM or ATS

  • Experience conducting competency-based candidate interviews and advising hiring managers on evaluation frameworks and profile decisions

  • KPI literacy: you have tracked recruiting data and used it to change a process, with a concrete example you can explain

  • German at C2 level and English at minimum C1, both required from day one, as searches run in both languages

  • Reliable self-management in a remote setup, careful documentation, and clear written communication

Nice-to-haves

  • Background in sales recruiting, executive search, or specialist/leadership hiring in a B2B or technology environment

  • Delivered employer branding work with concrete outputs, for example employer value proposition (EVP) development, career page content, candidate experience design, or career fair coordination

  • Familiarity with mid-market ATS or CRM-based recruiting platforms, for example Personio, Greenhouse, or Recruitee

  • Familiarity with the DACH talent market and its sourcing dynamics, particularly for niche or hard-to-fill profiles

How we work

selectry is fully remote within Germany, with our registered office in Berlin. The team is deliberately small so decisions are made quickly and work stays concrete. We use documented playbooks, clean process logic, and a tooling setup.

Technology supports the work. Humans verify and decide. That applies to how we run our product and to how we work internally.

There are no vanity metrics here. A good search is one where the right person was found, the process was fair, and the documentation lets us learn from it.

Working conditions

Location: 100% remote (DE), registered office in Berlin

Work model: Full-time, flexible hours with agreed collaboration windows

Contract: Permanent employment

Languages: German C2 (mandatory), English min. C1 (mandatory)

Salary: Discussed transparently in the first conversation

Start: As soon as possible

Holiday: 30 days plus public holidays in your federal state

How to apply

Apply with your CV. No formal cover letter required.

If you have relevant work samples, for example Boolean search strings, sourcing strategies, anonymised KPI dashboards, or process documentation, feel free to include them. They are welcome but not mandatory.

Our hiring process:

  1. 30-minute introduction call

  2. Skills interview in German, including a short live sourcing exercise

  3. Practical take-home personality test focused on your thinking logic and approach

  4. Final conversation with peers and Management, followed by offer discussion

We give clear, timely feedback at every stage.

Before you apply

If you match most of the profile but not every point, we would still welcome a conversation. The requirements above describe what matters for the role, not a checklist for perfection.

Equal opportunity and data protection

selectry GmbH is committed to equal opportunity. We hire for skill and potential. Applications are welcome regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or family status. Accessible process steps are available on request.

Your application data is processed exclusively for the purpose of this recruitment process in accordance with the GDPR. If you would like your data corrected or deleted, contact .

description: Deine Mission Du bringst Machine-Learning- und KI-Systeme aus dem Prototypen in eine saubere, robuste Produktion. Bei Agentur Philipp bauen wir KI-Lösungen für den Mittelstand, die messbar Arbeit abnehmen: Computer Vision, intelligente Dokumentenverarbeitung, RAG-Systeme, Sprach- und Automatisierungslösungen. Dafür suchen wir einen Machine Learning Engineer, der Modelle nicht nur trainieren kann, sondern sie als zuverlässige Systeme baut, integriert, testet und betreibt. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst und produktivierst Machine-Learning- und Deep-Learning-Modelle für reale Kundenprobleme. Du baust Computer-Vision-Lösungen für Bild-, Video- und Dokumentenverarbeitung, zum Beispiel mit OpenCV, YOLO, OCR oder Vision Language Models. Du entwickelst und integrierst RAG- und LLM-Systeme, die zuverlässig mit unternehmensinternen Daten arbeiten. Du entwickelst Python-Services und APIs, zum Beispiel mit FastAPI, und bindest sie in unsere Kundenlösungen ein. Du setzt Training, Fine-Tuning, Inference, Evaluation und Monitoring für Modelle sauber auf. Du sorgst mit Docker und Linux für reproduzierbare, wartbare und sichere Deployments. Du optimierst Inference und Infrastruktur für Leistung, Kosten und Zuverlässigkeit. Du arbeitest mit Data Scientists, Entwicklern und Delivery eng zusammen, damit aus fachlichen Anforderungen produktionsreife Systeme werden. Du dokumentierst Architektur, Schnittstellen und Betriebslogik so, dass andere im Team darauf aufbauen können. Das bringst du mit Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung mit PyTorch, TensorFlow oder vergleichbaren ML-Frameworks. Erfahrung darin, ML- oder Deep-Learning-Modelle in echten Anwendungen produktiv einzusetzen. Praktische Erfahrung mit Computer Vision, etwa OpenCV, YOLO, Object Detection, Segmentierung, OCR oder Bildklassifikation. Erfahrung mit LLMs und RAG-Systemen, inklusive Embeddings, Vektordatenbanken, Retrieval und Evaluation. Erfahrung mit Docker, Linux und dem Betrieb von Services oder Datenpipelines. Erfahrung mit APIs und Backend-Entwicklung, idealerweise FastAPI. Du denkst in Tests, Fehlerfällen, Logging, Monitoring und Wiederholbarkeit. Ein Notebook allein ist für dich kein fertiges Produkt. Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und übernimmst technische Verantwortung. Erfahrung mit ONNX, TensorRT, GPU-Inference, Quantisierung oder Fine-Tuning. Erfahrung mit AWS, Azure, GCP oder lokalen GPU- und On-Premise-Deployments. Erfahrung mit Dokumenten-KI, PDF-Extraktion, OCR oder multimodalen Modellen. Erfahrung mit JavaScript oder Node.js für die Anbindung an Produkt- und Automatisierungssysteme. Qualifikation Was dich bei uns erwartet Keine PoCs, die nach der Präsentation verschwinden. Du baust Systeme, die bei Kunden produktiv laufen müssen. Anspruchsvolle Projekte rund um KI-Kollegen, Computer Vision, Dokumentenverarbeitung, RAG und Automatisierung. Viel technischer Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Engineering-Standards mit aufzubauen. Direkter Kontakt zu den Menschen, die Entscheidungen treffen. Wenig Politik, kurze Wege und schnelle Umsetzung. Ein Team mit hohem fachlichen Anspruch und bodenständiger Zusammenarbeit. Remote-freundliches Arbeiten mit regelmäßigem persönlichem Austausch in Dingolfing. Für die finale Gesprächsrunde möchten wir dich vor Ort kennenlernen. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Moloco:</strong></p> <p>Moloco builds some of the most powerful AI advertising solutions in the world. Our name—short for "machine learning company"—reflects our core mission: democratizing access to the advanced AI that has historically been reserved for tech giants. Join us today and apply now!</p></div><p><strong>The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco:</strong></p> <p>Moloco is seeking a senior business development leader to drive revenue growth and close strategic partnerships for Moloco Commerce Media across Germany, DACH and Benelux. measured by achieving revenue targets, which will require building a strong pipeline, closing strategic deals, and expanding partnerships across the commerce and retail media ecosystem.</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate as a senior individual contributor, focused on originating and closing high-impact partnerships while supporting Moloco’s expansion across EMEA.</li> <li>Build and own a pipeline of commerce and retail platforms, closing deals to enable partners to launch and scale their ads businesses using Moloco’s machine learning solutions.</li> conferences, and executive forums, acting as a key evangelist for Commerce Media in EMEA.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven ability to engage with senior stakeholders to drive outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, or sales within retail, or marketplace companies—particularly within ads or monetization teams.</li> <li>Experience selling enterprise or platform solutions (e.g. SaaS, cloud, or media monetization).</li> <li>Proven ability to navigate complex organizations and manage multiple stakeholders.</li> <li>Strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in a title: Account Executive (m/w/d)
description: Caseware ist die globale KI-Plattform für Audit und Accounting. Gegründet vor über 35 Jahren in Toronto, nutzen heute mehr als 500.000 Anwender:innen in 130 Ländern unsere Lösungen, und über 36.000 Fachleute weltweit führen Caseware als Skill auf LinkedIn. Als wachstumsstarkes Technologieunternehmen, backed by Hg, beschleunigen wir die Transformation unserer Branche Richtung Cloud und AI, und bauen die nächste Generation von Audit- und Accounting-Workflows. Wenn du in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, das global skaliert, technologisch vorne liegt und echten Impact liefert, bist du bei uns richtig. Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Caseware wandelst Du Marktinteresse in messbare Ergebnisse. Du gewinnst neue Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen gezielt aus und erkennst Potenziale innerhalb deines Kundenportfolios frühzeitig. Mit ausgeprägter Abschlussstärke und einem klaren Gespür für Chancen schaffst du stabile Umsatzströme und nachhaltige Partnerschaften. 📍 Es handelt sich um eine unbefristete Vollzeitposition mit Sitz in Düsseldorf (oder Stuttgart) und einem flexiblen hybriden Arbeitsmodell. Was Du machst: Du treibst den aktiven Vertrieb der Caseware-Lösungen voran, führst beratungsorientierte Gespräche, präsentierst Produkte überzeugend und steuerst den gesamten Sales Cycle souverän. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Marketing, Consulting und Product Management zusammen. Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter, indem du die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Ansprechpartner genau verstehst. Du erhöhst den Marktanteil und den ARR in deinem Gebiet, indem du neue Kunden gewinnst, Abschlüsse verlässlich zum Erfolg führst und bestehende Accounts durch Up- und Cross-Selling ausbaust. Du entwickelst strategische Vertriebs- und Account-Pläne und setzt sie konsequent um. Dabei nutzt du bereichsübergreifende Ressourcen gezielt, um Umsatzpotenziale zu erschließen und Verkaufschancen erfolgreich zum Abschluss zu bringen. Du steuerst deine Pipeline strukturiert und diszipliniert und lieferst präzise Forecasts, die klare Entscheidungen ermöglichen und eine verlässliche Entwicklung in Richtung der Vertriebsziele unterstützen. Du stärkst die Marktpräsenz von Caseware und baust dein professionelles Netzwerk aktiv aus, indem du mit wichtigen Entscheidern und relevanten Branchenkontakten im Austausch bist. Du stellst sicher, dass alle Vertriebsaktivitäten, Kundendaten und Vertragsdetails vollständig und korrekt im CRM dokumentiert sind, damit Transparenz und effiziente Abläufe jederzeit gewährleistet sind. Was Du mitbringst: Du kommunizierst überzeugend, trittst souverän auf und schaffst es, schnell tragfähige Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern aufzubauen. Du hast nachweislich Erfolge in der Gewinnung von Neukunden und im strategischen Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen erzielt. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im SaaS- oder Tech-Vertrieb mit und hast Vertriebsziele eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und erreicht. Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung und schaffst damit die Grundlage für nachhaltige Kundenpartnerschaften. Du gehst mit Neugier, Motivation und einer pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Haltung auf Kunden und ihre Herausforderungen zu. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für vertriebliche Potenziale und verstehst, wie sich Kundenbedürfnisse in konkreten Mehrwert übersetzen lassen. Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Audit, Finance oder Accounting sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Was wir Dir bieten: • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Hybrid-Setup: Klare Mischung aus Präsenz- und Remote-Arbeit, gemeinsam definierte Kernzeiten und ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung im Arbeitsalltag.   • Attraktives Gesamtpaket: Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt mit variablen Bestandteilen, ergänzt durch globale und lokale Benefits sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge.   • Internationales Arbeitsumfeld: Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Kulturen, Englisch als Arbeitssprache und verlässliche, strukturierte Abstimmung über Teams hinweg. • Sinnstiftendes Produkt mit Kund:innen-Impact: Caseware unterstützt Organisationen dabei, Audit- und Financial-Reporting-Prozesse effizienter und verlässlicher zu gestalten, mit Cloud- und KI-gestützten Lösungen.   • Verantwortung und Entwicklung im Job: Du übernimmst Ownership für relevante Themen, bringst Ideen aktiv ein und entwickelst dich innerhalb der Rolle sowie perspektivisch im Unternehmen weiter, fachlich oder in Richtung Führung.   • Healthcare & Wellbeing: Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellbeing-Leistungen für dich und deine Familie, orientiert an lokalen Standards. Über Caseware: Caseware entwickelt Software für Wirtschaftsprüfungen, Unternehmen und öffentliche Einrichtungen. Unsere Teams arbeiten eng zusammen, verbessern bestehende Lösungen und entwickeln neue Produkte, die auf die Anforderungen der Zukunft ausgerichtet sind. Mit der Investition von Hg Capital im Jahr 2020 haben wir eine wichtige Wachstumsphase begonnen, in der wir konsequent in Menschen, Produkte und Strukturen investieren. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt sind uns wichtig. Wir möchten Teams aufbauen, die unterschiedliche Hintergründe und Perspektiven einbringen. Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Herkunft sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Wenn du während des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung benötigst, kannst du uns jederzeit unter ----- kontaktieren. Du definierst technische Standards für zentrale Infrastrukturthemen wie Server, Virtualisierung, Azure, Client Management, Storage und Backup und erstellst fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Teamlead, IT-Leitung und Management. raw.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who enjoys building trusted data foundations and enabling teams to make better decisions, measure outcomes, and demonstrate the impact of their work.

  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

raw.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
raw.description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a motivated and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join our Team Greenrock – Demand Division. 

Our Tech team owns Flix's Revenue Management System (RMS), a production system with a direct commercial impact. We are looking for a colleague who will play an active role in shaping the next generation of the RMS by leveraging their deep expertise in revenue management. 

This is a hands-on senior role in a non-greenfield environment: delivering meaningful change requires care, conviction, and patience. 

About the Role

  • Work closely with commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped projects and respond to operational inquiries.
  • Translate revenue management theory and industry best practices into concrete, testable improvements, from idea and experimentation through to production rollout.
  • Co-own the evolution of the entire system through regular collaboration and discussions with peers across your team and neighboring engineering teams.
  • Contribute to the technical health, reliability, and observability of the existing system. 

About You

Education and Revenue Management expertise (must-have)

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
  • Solid theoretical foundation in RM: demand modeling, dynamic pricing, and network revenue management.
  • Applied experience with RM or pricing tech solutions in transportation, travel, hospitality, retail, or a comparable domain is a big plus. 

Engineering and data craft 

  • Strong hands-on Python (including NumPy, Polars, Pandas, SciPy) and comfort with SQL on large datasets.
  • Production-code experience is welcome but not required; what we expect is genuine interest in writing, reviewing, and maintaining code that runs reliably in production. 

Soft skills 

  • Excellent communication: you explain complex quantitative concepts or optimisation trade-offs to technical and non-technical, commercial audiences alike, and you enjoy educating and advocating for sound RM solutions.
  • Senior judgment: you scope your own work, balance short-term fixes with long-term direction, and respect the constraints of an existing system. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><strong>About the Role</strong></strong></p> <p>A fast-paced, global business with significant growth ambitions, and an Accounting function entering a period of transformation to support that growth. This role will lead a team of accounting professionals and drive an improvement agenda that scales the function to meet the demands of a fast-paced business — through hands-on ownership of the numbers, critical thinking on every estimate and judgement, and continued development of the function beyond process compliance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></strong></p> <p><strong><strong>Own the Global General Ledger &amp; Financial Close</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Ultimate accountability for the Global GL under US GAAP, including the completeness, accuracy, and timely close of all entities worldwide</li> <li>Build and lead a scalable end-to-end close operating model; set standards, drive consistency, and coach the team to execute with rigour</li> <li>Maintain the quality of balance sheet reconciliations and close deliverables; identify and resolve issues in a timely manner, applying critical evaluation alongside sound accounting and commercial judgement</li> <li>Estimates, accruals, and accounting positions that accurately reflect the pace and trajectory of the business, with the accounting telling the true story behind the numbers</li> <li>Deliver authoritative monthly and quarterly P&amp;L and balance sheet flux analysis — clear on commercial and accounting drivers, risks and opportunities, and material one-off items&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>Apply and Uphold Technical Accounting Standards</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>The senior escalation point for accounting matters across the business; Develop the Team</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Coach and develop a team of accounting professionals, building technical capability and succession depth within the function</li> <li>Create a high-performing team culture grounded in clear expectations, mutual accountability, meaningful development, and direct, honest communication</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Across the Organisation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strong relationships with Finance and Commercial business partners; bring commercial perspective to accounting judgements</li> <li>&nbsp; Represent the Accounting function with confidence and credibility at senior management level&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></strong></p> <p><strong><strong>Experience &amp; Qualifications</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Fully-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA or equivalent)</li> <li>Significant post-qualification experience in financial accounting leadership, with full GL accountability and ownership of the end-to-end close cycle across a complex, multi-entity, global business — including the completeness and accuracy of the numbers</li> <li>Proven track record of leading and developing teams of qualified accountants and people managers&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong>Skills &amp; Ways of Working</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep technical grounding in US GAAP, with the confidence to take and defend positions on complex matters</li> <li>Numbers-first with strong ownership of accuracy — credible at senior stakeholder level, telling the story behind the numbers and comfortable pushing back when warranted</li> <li>A natural change leader with an improvement mindset — builds the case, brings the team along, and delivers lasting change at pace</li> <li>A high-performing people leader, invested in growth and outcomes</li> <li>At ease in fast-paced, global complexity, fluent across both strategic and detailed work</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li>Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year</li> <li>Focus on mental health and well-being: <ul> <li>Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth</li> <li>Company-paid subscription to Headspace</li> <li>Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)</li> </ul> </li> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday</li> <li>Paid volunteer time</li> <li>Focus on your career growth: <ul> <li>Development Dollars</li> <li>Leadership development</li> <li>Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings</li> </ul> </li> <li>Travel Discounts</li> <li>Employee Resource Groups</li> <li>20 days of paid time off</li> <li>Private health and dental insurance</li> <li>Life and Disability insurance</li> </ul> <p>We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u>.</p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h3></h3> <p><strong>This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3>Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring</h3> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates <a href="https://grafana.com/products/cloud/synthetic-monitoring/">Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring</a>, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.</p> <p>Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.</p> <p>The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.</p> <p>The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.</p> <p>As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Software Engineers who are passionate about building reliable systems and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></p> <p>As a Software Engineer on the Synthetic Monitoring squad, you will work across the whole system - Go services and agents on the backend, a TypeScript/React application on the frontend and you'll be expected to reason about it as one system, not two halves. Specifically, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own features end-to-end across the stack</strong>: from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React</li> <li><strong>Design and evolve systems, not just features</strong>: contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales</li> <li><strong>Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows</strong> that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform</li> <li><strong>Make the product operable at enterprise scale</strong>: the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence</li> <li><strong>Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables</strong> and iterate quickly based on feedback</li> <li><strong>Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation</strong>: our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature</li> <li><strong>Be a part of the team's on-call rotation</strong> and take ownership of the services you're running</li> </ul> <p>We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Technologies you'll work with:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)</li> <li>TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)</li> <li>Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure</li> <li>k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)</li> <li>Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are <strong>comfortable working in a remote-first company</strong>; communication is key.</li> <li>For us, working together means being <strong>collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful</strong>. We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.</li> <li><strong>Strong Go, or a path to it.</strong> We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.</li> <li><strong>Operational mindset.</strong> You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.</li> <li>You are a <strong>systems thinker</strong>: you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatism and short feedback loops.</strong> You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. You are able to design a solution, get feedback, and write a prototype by yourself - the ability to work on your own is crucial.</li> <li>You have a good understanding of <strong>a software development process that takes a user-centered approach</strong>. You easily build an understanding of the users' context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value.</li> <li>You use <strong>AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow</strong> - whether for accelerating exploration, code review, or reasoning through design tradeoffs - and you're thoughtful about where they help and where they don't.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience designing or operating multi-tenant SaaS systems at scale</li> <li>Experience with observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Sentry, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes in a production environment</li> <li>Familiarity with k6, Playwright, or browser automation at scale</li> <li>Experience contributing to or maintaining open source projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Rewards:</strong></p> <div class="content-conclusion"> <div> <p class="p1">In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 72<span data-sheets-root="1">,000</span> - GBP 90<span data-sheets-root="1">,000</span>.&nbsp; Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.</li> <li><strong>Operational mindset.</strong> You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.</li> <li>You are a <strong>systems thinker</strong>: you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Pragmatism and short feedback loops.</strong> You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Eucalyptus</h3> <p>We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Legal Counsel to join our growing legal team and support the company's global sales organisation. This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong partnership with Sales and other business stakeholders, providing pragmatic legal advice while ensuring that legal, regulatory and commercial risks are appropriately identified, assessed and managed.</p> <p>The successful candidate will act as a trusted adviser to the business, helping stakeholders navigate complex customer negotiations while exercising sound judgement regarding risk. They will understand when to find creative solutions to move discussions forward and when it is necessary to escalate, challenge assumptions or recommend alternative approaches to protect the company's interests.</p> <p>This role is ideal for a confident, adaptable lawyer who thrives in a fast-paced software environment, enjoys tackling complex negotiations, and is passionate about helping the business succeed.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations and other business stakeholders to support customer and channel transactions.</li> <li>Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS, BaaS, software, professional services, channel (including aggregator, reseller and GSI relationships) and NDAs.</li> <li>Provide practical, commercially focused legal advice to Sales and business stakeholders, supporting negotiations through clear, pragmatic guidance while identifying, communicating and managing material legal, regulatory, privacy and commercial risks, and advising on compliance requirements, data protection obligations and internal approval processes.</li> <li>Develop practical and defensible solutions to complex contractual and commercial issues, applying sound judgement to balance risk, identify appropriate mitigations and determine when escalation is required.</li> <li>Anticipate potential contractual, legal or operational issues and take proactive steps to address them efficiently and reduce the risk of disputes or delays.</li> <li>Support the development and continuous improvement of contract templates, negotiation playbooks and legal processes, and develop and deliver training and awareness programs to promote best practices and understanding of legal risks, contracting principles and company processes.</li> <li>Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the Legal department and contribute to a positive, high-performing team culture.</li> </ul> <h4>What You’ll Bring</h4> <ul> <li>Qualified lawyer with significant (10-15+ years) post-qualification experience gained in a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department but including significant in-house experience.</li> <li>Strong commercial contracts background, ideally within a software, SaaS, cloud technology or broader technology company.</li> <li>Excellent drafting, contract review and negotiation skills.</li> <li>Extensive experience negotiating complex customer and partner agreements.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders in a practical, succinct and commercially focused manner.</li> <li>Experience supporting sales organizations and working closely with commercial stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Experience advising on privacy and data protection issues arising in commercial technology transactions, including customer contracting requirements relating to the processing, transfer, storage and protection of data.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Strong commercial judgement and ability to assess risk proportionately. Comfortable challenging assumptions and driving constructive discussions to achieve the best outcome for the business.</li> <li>Proactive, self-motivated and willing to take ownership of complex matters from start to finish.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of matters and conflicting priorities.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts, articulate recommendations and options, and deliver practical advice that is accessible to a wide range of stakeholders.</li> <li>Sound judgement and the confidence to make risk-based decisions in situations where there may not be a clear precedent or established playbook.</li> </ul> <div class="content-pay-transparency"> <div through Veeam Cares</li> <li>Private medical, dental, and vision insurance with dependent enrolment</li> <li>Life insurance with enhanced coverage and global 24/7 protection</li> <li>Income protection after 26 weeks, covering a portion of salary</li> <li>Defined contribution pension plan with employer match</li> <li>Worldwide travel insurance for business and leisure, with option to enroll dependents</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program with therapy, legal, and financial support, plus online GP services and wellbeing programs</li> <li>Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> <p>#LI-MP1</p><div title: (Senior) CRM / Lifecycle Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Retention entscheidet, ob aus dem ersten Kauf eine Beziehung über das ganze Hunde- und Katzenleben wird und genau dieses Spielfeld gehört Dir. Du bekommst Ownership über Lifecycle CRM bei 7 starken Petfood-Marken : Du verantwortest unsere Automations und Kampagnen von der Idee bis zum Go-Live - mit modernen Tools, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und direktem Impact. Du arbeitest selbstständig, triffst Entscheidungen und verbesserst schnell auf Basis von Ergebnissen. Du baust, betreust und optimierst Klaviyo-Flows und -Kampagnen für alle 7 Marken parallel (u.a. Wolfsblut, Herrmann's Manufaktur, pets Premium) - vom Welcome Flow bis zur Reaktivierung. Du verantwortest E-Mail als Kernkanal . Weitere Kanäle wie Print-Mailings, WhatsApp, SMS und RCS bauen wir perspektivisch aus - hier bringst Du kanalübergreifendes Denken ein. Du bringst Maßnahmen eigenständig live und iterierst auf Basis von Ergebnissen. Geschwindigkeit vor Perfektion : Du testest, misst und schärfst schnell nach. Du machst aus Daten konkrete Maßnahmen: RFM, Segmente, Produkt- und Engagement-Daten, Tierprofile, Predictions (Rebuy, CLV, Churn) werden bei Dir zu personalisierter, relevanter Ansprache. Storytelling ist Deine Stärke : Bei Produktion und Skalierung unterstützen Dich moderne Tools und Automatisierung - Du bringst die zündende Hookline, das initiale Design-Briefing und die emotionale Ansprache aufs leere Blatt. Du setzt AI- und Automatisierungstools selbstverständlich ein, um schneller von der Idee zum Live-Test zu kommen und mehr Zeit für Konzept und Creative zu gewinnen. Du kommunizierst Ergebnisse klar und auf den Punkt - intern wie mit unseren Marken-Stakeholdern und du arbeitest als Sparring-Partner auf Augenhöhe. Was Du mitbringst Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Hands-on-Erfahrung im CRM-/Lifecycle-Marketing mit messbaren Ergebnissen , idealerweise im E-Commerce/D2C. Sehr gute praktische Klaviyo-Kenntnisse (oder vergleichbare Marketing-Automation-Plattform). Du denkst in Customer Journeys und verstehst Retention-Mechaniken (Rebuy, CLV, Churn). AI-native Arbeiten ist für Dich selbstverständlich : Du setzt LLMs, n8n, Cursor und ähnliche Tools aktiv im Arbeitsalltag ein. Du baust selbst : Flows, Segmente und Templates entstehen in Deinen Händen. Du bringst sie eigenständig live, lernst aus Ergebnissen und iterierst schnell. Segmentierung, Trigger, A/B-Tests und Deliverability beherrschst Du sicher. Mit Consent und Datenschutz (DSGVO) gehst Du selbstverständlich sauber und verantwortungsvoll um. Du bist datengetrieben und übersetzt unsere Looker-Dashboards in konkrete Maßnahmen. description: About SugarAI UK Limited SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI. We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next. More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. your review is a real gate, not a formality   Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly   Feature Delivery   Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments   Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates   Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers   Code Quality & Review   Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; raw.description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

title: Global Director of Logistics & Fulfilment
description: <p>More than one third of the food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste!</p> <p>At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: To inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. We are the world's #1 app for fighting food waste and we work with thousands of restaurants and food retailers to make their surplus food available to local consumers. The magic of Too Good To Go has expanded rapidly across Europe, the US, and Canada, with over 500 million meals saved across our 20&nbsp; countries to date.</p> <p>We’re proud of what we’ve achieved so far, but did we mention the issue is huge? We always want to raise the bar and that’s where you come in.</p> <p>Your mission at Too Good to Go…</p> <p>We’re looking for an exceptional Global Director of Logistics &amp; Fulfillment to lead the end-to-end logistics and fulfillment engine behind Parcels across transportation, warehousing, repack, pick/pack, and last-mile delivery. This is a strategic role with a highly operational core: you’ll define the global fulfillment strategy, build the partner ecosystem, and drive the day-to-day performance and continuous improvement needed to scale reliably in an agile, high-growth environment.</p> <p>You will report to the VP Operations, Parcels and sit on the Global Parcels Leadership Team, leading a global organization of 15+ team members across 10+ countries.</p> <p>Our Parcels business is a transformative solution that enables food manufacturers to effectively reduce food waste while extracting value from surplus food. Through direct purchasing from food manufacturers, Too Good To Go carefully curates and assembles the purchased products into bundles, which are then offered to our users at a discount of ~50% off of original retail.&nbsp; Sold through our existing Too Good To Go app, customers can opt to have their orders conveniently delivered to their doorstep or pick it up from a nearby location. Instead of allowing these products to go to waste, manufacturers decrease their environmental impact, optimise their revenue by maximising the value of saved food, and enhance product visibility in the market.</p> <p>In the role, you will:</p> <p><strong>Build and scale a best-in-class fulfillment network (strategy + execution)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and optimize the full Parcels logistics value chain: inbound to warehouse, repack/kitting, inventory management, pick/pack, carrier handoff, last-mile delivery, and returns/claims.</li> <li>Architect and execute a logistics and fulfillment strategy that supports cost efficiency, service quality, and international growth.</li> <li>Operate comfortably in ambiguity: create structure fast, make trade-offs, and iterate as we scale.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own and manage the 3PL and carrier ecosystem</strong></p> <ul> <li>Evaluate, select, and onboard 3PLs, fulfillment partners, and data/visibility providers; negotiate commercial and legal terms and ensure strong governance.</li> <li>Define and implement operational standards with partners: facility/site design, process flows, repack specifications, SOPs, WMS/data integration, ERP migrations and capacity planning.</li> <li>Lead quarterly and annual business reviews; own partner performance against SLAs and drive corrective action when service or cost drifts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Drive performance through S&amp;OP, planning, and inventory discipline</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be an active driver of the monthly S&amp;OP cadence, connecting and challenging demand forecasts, supply planning, capacity, and operational constraints.</li> <li>Partner closely with Commercial and Supply Planning to maintain healthy inventory: reduce obsolescence, shrink, and write-offs, and improve inventory turns.</li> <li>Build dashboards and operating rhythms that create transparency and decision speed across markets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead teams and cross-functional execution in a matrix</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a global logistics organization; set clear priorities, empower local leaders, and raise the operational bar across markets.</li> <li>Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Projects/CI, and local Operations teams to execute against business goals.</li> <li>Lead complex cross-functional initiatives (e.g., carrier transitions, new country launches, peak readiness, system implementation, process changes).</li> </ul> <p>What success looks like for this role:</p> <ul> <li>A scalable, repeatable fulfillment model that behaves like a modern e-commerce operation: reliable delivery, strong unit economics, and operational control.</li> <li>Strong partner performance and accountability: clear SLAs, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Define and implement service metrics (e.g., on-time delivery, refunds, delivery quality) while driving down cost-to-serve.</li> <li>Inventory health and planning maturity: fewer write-offs, fewer surprises, faster decision cycles.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>What is required for this role:</p> <ul> <li>Experience in senior logistics / fulfillment leadership (or similar), ideally in e-commerce, food delivery, meal kits, retail, or food/CPG supply chain.</li> <li>Proven experience building and managing multi-country logistics operations with multiple 3PLs and carrier partners.</li> <li>Strong track record in warehouse process design and optimization (directly or through 3PLs): pick/pack, repack/kitting, layout, capacity planning.</li> <li>Experience with cross-border and pan-European parcel networks is a strong advantage.</li> <li>Experience in a global matrix organization is a plus.</li> <li>Strong analytical capability (KPIs, dashboards, root-cause problem solving) and planning discipline (S&amp;OP, capacity, inventory).</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management—able to align teams, challenge constructively, and drive decisions.</li> </ul> <p>You’ll succeed in this role if you are:</p> <ul> <li>A strategic operator: you can design the system and also roll up your sleeves to make it work day to day.</li> <li>Comfortable moving fast: you can deliver outcomes in an agile, iterative environment without waiting for perfect information.</li> <li>Commercially sharp: you understand unit economics, contract levers, and how to scale with partners without losing control.</li> <li>Calm under pressure: you can handle peak periods, partner incidents, and operational fire-fighting while still improving the system.</li> </ul> <p>Our values:</p> <ul> <li>We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We can do it if we win together as Waste Warriors with no ego. We believe in a #oneteam.</li> <li>We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers and elevate one another.</li> <li>We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.</li> <li>We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving.&nbsp;</li> <li>We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>What we have to offer:</p> <ul> <li>A rare opportunity to work in a social impact company (and certified B Corporation!) where you get to wake up every day knowing you’re achieving positive change.</li> <li>The experience of being part of an international company with 1300+ enthusiastic and highly talented teammates across 20 countries (and growing).</li> <li>Strong personal as well as professional development in an intense and high-growth scale-up environment.</li> <li>An open company culture where you have the independence and room to unleash your creativity.</li> <li>A strong team culture where successes are celebrated together.</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em data-stringify-type="italic">A Movement for Everyone</em><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">We want to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. With that mission, it’s only natural that we want to build a diverse and inclusive team of highly capable individuals who are passionate about doing things in a better way. We strongly believe we all excel and are more creative when we’re allowed to be ourselves, and we’re committed to a culture where all of us belong.</em><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">We are an equal opportunity employer and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Help build our next-generation data platform, using a modern technology stack that will enable new products and analytics capabilities across the company.
  • Design, build, and own end-to-end data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver high-quality data products used both for internal analytics and to power features experienced directly by our customers.
  • Build, operate, and continuously improve the core data platform, including databases, clusters, streaming infrastructure, and other platform services, with a focus on reliability, scalability and performance.
  • Continuously improve our engineering practices by enhancing CI/CD pipelines, automating workflows, adopting modern developer tooling, and leveraging LLMs to improve developer productivity.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for a Data Engineer with a strong software engineering mindset who enjoys building data platforms and is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

  • Technical Skills: experience writing code in Python, strong SQL skills, and experience with cloud-based solutions on AWS or GCP.
  • Nice to have technical Skills: ClickHouse, Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Kafka, MySQL, dbt, Airflow.
  • Soft Skills: we are looking for a collaborative engineer who enjoys working closely with teammates, who proactively identifies opportunities for improvement and helps drive them to completion, with the ability to explain technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Separate cat ward, isolation facilities and excellent staff amenities
  • Part of a supportive three-practice network alongside our Stokesley and Copeland clinics, offering additional clinical support and expertise

  • Friendly, highly experienced nursing and client care team with a strong culture of teamwork and knowledge sharing
 

How You'll Make a Difference

 

As a Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you'll play a key role in delivering exceptional patient care while supporting the development of the wider clinical team.

Working Pattern

  • Full-time position
  • 40 hours across four days
  • Shared Saturday rota
  • Flexible working discussions welcomed

Life in Guisborough

 
Located on the edge of the stunning North York Moors, Guisborough offers the perfect blend of countryside, coastline, and community living.
