How You’ll Make a Difference

 

As a Senior Veterinary Nurse, you will play a key role in delivering high standards of nursing care while supporting and developing colleagues within the practice.

 

You’ll work collaboratively with veterinary surgeons and the wider practice team to support excellent patient and client care. You'll also act as a source of guidance for the nursing team and contribute to maintaining and improving clinical standards, workflows and patient outcomes.

 

Working Pattern

 
* Ideally 40 hours per week; however, we will accept part-time applications also 
* 4 x 10-hour shifts between 8 am - 7:30 pm 
 
 

General Responsibilities

 

*Deliver high-quality nursing care across theatre, inpatient care, diagnostics and medical cases

*Run a range of nurse consultations, including post-operative checks, weight management clinics, puppy and kitten clinics, senior pet clinics, and other preventative healthcare appointments

*Support the Lead Veterinary Surgeon with the day-to-day coordination of the nursing team and clinical areas

*Lead by example, promoting high standards of patient care, infection control, and clinical best practice

*Mentor, coach and support Student Veterinary Nurses, Animal Nursing Assistants, and less experienced RVNs to encourage their professional development

*Assist with nurse training, inductions, and ongoing clinical development 

*Contribute to clinical governance, quality improvement initiatives, and practice protocols

*Support stock control, equipment maintenance, and the efficient running of clinical areas

*Deliver exceptional client care, providing clear advice and education to support preventative healthcare and treatment plans

 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 

You are an experienced and confident Registered Veterinary Nurse who enjoys supporting others and leading by example. You’ll bring:

 
* Registration as a Veterinary Nurse with the RCVS
* Significant experience in clinical practice with strong medical and surgical nursing skills
* Experience and aptitude for supporting, mentoring or coaching colleagues
* Strong communication and organisational skills
* A proactive approach to quality improvement, learning and professional development
 

How We’ll Support You

 

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

 
* A senior nursing role with opportunities to influence clinical standards and ways of working
*Access advanced, subject-specific learning through our dedicated Nurse Academy while gaining the leadership skills to inspire the next generation
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities into leadership or specialist nursing roles
* Ongoing learning and development supported by experienced colleagues and practice teams
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community, and continuous improvement
*An interest in nurse consults 
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
* 6.6 weeks' annual leave
* Additional annual leave for your birthday, which will be added to your holiday allowance
* Increasing holiday allowance based on length of service
* Enhanced family-friendly policies, including maternity, paternity, adoption, shared parental and surrogacy pay
* Private Medical Insurance
* Employee wellbeing initiatives including Healthcare Cash Plan and Cycle to Work scheme
* £550 CPD allowance plus 24hrs paid leave
* RCVS and VDS fees covered

We are looking for a confident RVN to join our team at Hamilton Specialist Referrals as a Senior Neurology Veterinary Nurse on a full-time basis.

 
Hamilton Specialist Referrals was born of the belief that there is room for a new wave of veterinary excellence across the UK. There is a strong focus on providing a personal and reassuring client experience from first contact through to discharge. Excellent clinical care delivered in a friendly and supportive manner to referring vets is paramount to the team. The hospital is operational 24 hours a day, 365 days a year and is able to offer the most advanced treatment options available for orthopaedic, neurology, soft tissue, and internal medicine cases. We have a dedicated Imaging suite, which includes a 16-slice CT scanner, 1.5 Tesla MRI, fluoroscopy, separate radiography and ultrasound rooms.
 
 
Our core ethos here at HSR is based on appreciation of our staff. Curating and developing a friendly, close-knit team is a central part of our working environment. Further qualifications and certificates are encouraged and fully supported as we feel strongly about our employees' right to enjoy work and develop rewarding careers. We have a dedicated team of Specialists, Referral clinicians, RVNs and Support teams.
 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 

You will set the standard for excellence within the Neurology Nursing Department, championing high-quality patient care and evidence-based clinical practice. Working closely with the Clinical Team Leader (CTL), you will support the day-to-day leadership, organisation, and development of the nursing team while fostering a positive learning culture through mentoring, coaching, and identifying training needs.

 

You will coordinate nursing services and workflow across procedure areas, ensuring efficient service delivery, effective resource utilisation, and optimal patient flow. As part of a rota-based clinical role, you will provide hands-on support across neurology, medicine, surgery, anaesthesia, and diagnostic services as required, leading by example to maintain high standards of nursing care and operational efficiency.

 

In addition, you will drive continuous improvement initiatives across the department, seeking opportunities to enhance patient outcomes, strengthen team performance, and improve operational effectiveness.

 

Working Pattern

 
* Full-time position covering 40 hours per week across a rolling 6-week rota
* 4-day working week comprising 4 x 9.25-hour shifts
* 1 in 6 weekend rota (Saturday and Sunday)
* Bank holiday rota, currently averaging 2 shifts per year
* Part-time applications also welcomed
 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 

You are an experienced Registered Veterinary Nurse with a keen interest in diversifying your clinical skills and a desire to specialise in providing gold-standard care to patients with a variety of conditions. You’ll bring:

 
* Registration as a Veterinary Nurse with the RCVS
* Significant experience in clinical practice with an interest in neurological cases
* Experience working with complex cases in a referral or advanced-care setting would be advantageous
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams
* A commitment to evidence-based practice, clinical governance, and continuous improvement
 

How We’ll Support You

 

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

 
* A specialist nursing role within a referral environment delivering complex and rewarding caseloads
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities within referral nursing and leadership roles
* Ongoing learning and development to support advanced clinical and professional growth
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, learning, and continuous improvement
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
* 6.6 weeks' annual leave
* Increasing holiday allowance based on length of service
* Enhanced family-friendly policies, including maternity, paternity, adoption, shared parental and surrogacy pay
* Private Medical Insurance
* Employee wellbeing initiatives including Healthcare Cash Plan and Cycle to Work scheme
* £550 CPD allowance plus 24hrs paid leave and certificate support
* RCVS and VDS fees covered
* Pension scheme
* Discounted veterinary care
* Voluntary benefits: choose from a range of benefits to suit you, including Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme and access to discounts and cashback with hundreds of participating retailers
 

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

 

Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

raw.description:
About Us 

IVC Evidensia is the UK and Europe’s leading veterinary care group, made up of over 900 practices and referral hospitals, united by a shared purpose of happier animals, happier owners. 

At IVC Evidensia, we believe careers should be built without limits. Our people are supported to make more impact, access more career opportunities, and play an active role in their local and professional communities. Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career. 

As part of Central Functions, you will be part of the teams that support and enable our network of over 2,500 practices across 20 countries, driving operational excellence, innovation, and strategic impact across the business.  

Our Technology teams are responsible for the systems and infrastructure that make that work - everything our healthcare professionals need to deliver world-class care. From keeping on top of patient records, health plans, client communications, diary management and dispensing, our teams have a lot to think about and need smarter ways to provide the convenience and expertise that modern Pet owners have come to expect.

The Data Engineering Manager is a UK Remote based role with occasional office attendance of around once or twice a month.
 
Team
Join our growing Data function as we modernise our entire data ecosystem and transition from a traditional SQL data warehouse to a cutting‑edge Databricks Lakehouse architecture. You’ll lead a high‑performing Data Engineering team (typically 4–8 engineers), working closely with Product Managers, Architects, Infrastructure, Service teams, and regional data partners to deliver a federated data platform that powers insight and innovation across the organisation.
As part of the wider Technology group, you’ll report into the VP of Software Engineering and collaborate regularly with senior stakeholders. This is a key leadership role shaping how we build, deliver, and evolve our data products.
 
 
What will you be doing?
As our Data Engineering Manager, you'll lead a high‑performing team to deliver reliable, high‑quality data products and drive our transition to a modern Databricks Lakehouse platform.
Lead & develop the team - build a culture of trust, accountability, and continuous improvement, with clear coaching and performance support.
Own delivery & outcomes - ensure the team ships valuable data products in small, frequent increments, with clear visibility of progress, risks, and quality.
Drive technical direction - guide engineering decisions, support trade‑offs, and maintain the health, reliability, and observability of our data systems.
Improve ways of working - champion outcome‑focused, pragmatic processes that help the team move faster and safer, using metrics and feedback to evolve how you work.
Partner with Product - work closely with Product Managers to shape roadmaps, define priorities, and balance short‑term delivery with long‑term platform health.
 
 
What are we looking for?
A proven leader who can build, support, and challenge a high‑performing engineering team.
Strong experience delivering data products in modern data platforms (SQL Warehouse & Azure Databricks Lakehouse).
A track record of managing delivery, guiding engineering decisions, and driving measurable outcomes.
Deep understanding of data engineering, platform reliability, and best‑practice ways of working.
Someone who balances empathy with high standards, and creates a culture where people do their best work.
Exceptional communication skills — clear, honest, and able to influence at all levels.
A mindset focused on value, quality, and iterative delivery.
 
#LI-WL1
What’s in it for you? 
At IVC Evidensia, we’re committed to supporting your development and wellbeing.

When you join us, you’ll benefit from: 
A role with real business impact supporting teams across the organisation 
Clear career pathways with progression opportunities within Central Functions and beyond 
Ongoing learning and development supported by tailored programmes and resources 
A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, innovation, and continuous improvement 
Flexible working with a remote first working policy

Benefits 
Healthcare Cash Plan 
Cycle to Work scheme 
Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme 
Voluntary benefits: choose from a range of benefits to suit you 
Discounted staff pet care  
Access to discounts/cashback with hundreds of participating retailers 
 
Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging 
At IVC Evidensia we are committed to Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging, we are keen to hear from candidates from all minority and diverse groups. As a Disability Confident Employer, we are keen to hear from candidates with disabilities and long-term health conditions and would be happy to discuss any reasonable adjustments needed during the recruitment process.

Clinical Director - Small Animal
Rosehill Veterinary Clinic - Plymouth

Salary up to £80,000 DOE, Welcome Bonus up to £5,000 and Relocation Allowance up to £5,000

 

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

 

We’re excited to offer a rare opportunity for a Director of Practice and Clinical Services to join Rosehill Vets. This is an ideal role for an experienced Veterinary Surgeon looking to combine hands-on clinical work with the chance to shape and lead a well-established practice.

 

You’ll spend around 75% of your time in practice, enjoying a balanced mix of consultations and surgery, while also playing a key role in mentoring colleagues, supporting case discussions and helping develop less experienced vets and new graduates.

 

Practice Highlights

 
* Recently refurbished practice just outside Plymouth city centre
* Balanced mix of consultations and surgery
* Approximately 75% clinical and 25% leadership responsibilities
* Digital radiography and dental radiography
* Ultrasound facilities
* Multi-parameter monitoring equipment
* Experienced team of Veterinary Surgeons, RVNs and Client Care colleagues
* Opportunity to mentor colleagues and support new graduate development
* Strong emphasis on clinical autonomy and high standards of patient care
* Surgical bias role
 

You’ll be joining a friendly and experienced team of vets, RVNs and a dedicated client care team, all based in a welcoming, refurbished practice.

 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 

As Director of Practice & Clinical Services, you will provide senior clinical leadership across a large practice, hospital or group of services, setting and delivering the clinical vision in line with inspiring vet care’s strategy, standards and values.

 

You’ll oversee clinical governance, quality improvement and performance across services, working closely with senior operational leaders to drive excellent patient outcomes, sustainable service delivery and a strong clinical culture. This role combines strategic leadership with accountability for clinical standards, people development and continuous improvement.

 

Working Pattern

 
* Full-time role working four days per week
* 1 in 4 Saturday mornings, 9:00am–2:00pm
* No out-of-hours responsibilities
* No on-call commitment
* Out-of-hours provided by a nearby IVC hospital
* Part-time applications of 30+ hours per week welcomed
 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 

You are a senior veterinary leader with a strong track record of clinical excellence and strategic leadership. You’ll bring:

 
* A Veterinary degree with RCVS registration and significant senior clinical experience
* Proven leadership experience within a complex veterinary or healthcare setting
* Strong expertise in clinical governance, quality improvement and regulatory compliance
* The ability to set and deliver a clinical vision while leading and developing high-performing teams
* Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills
 

How We’ll Support You

 

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting you in a senior clinical leadership role. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

 
* The opportunity to shape and lead clinical strategy across a large practice, hospital or group of services
* Senior-level influence over clinical standards, governance and service development
* Support to further develop strategic leadership, change management and organisational impact
* Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC Academy training centres and role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities into wider senior or executive leadership roles
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, innovation and continuous improvement
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
* 6.6 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
* BVA membership, VDS cover and RCVS fees
* Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
* Retail discounts and cashback offers
* Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets
 

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

 

Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK's number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.
 
This is more than a leadership appointment. It's an opportunity to shape the future of equine veterinary care in one of the UK's most unique regions.
 

A Rare Leadership Opportunity in the Highlands

 
Kessock Equine Vets is the only dedicated equine practice in the Highlands, delivering a highly respected 24/7 ambulatory and emergency service to a loyal and diverse client base.
 
With strong foundations, an excellent reputation and a committed clinical team, the practice is well positioned for its next chapter. We're looking for an experienced equine vet ready to step into a Clinical Director role, taking ownership of clinical standards, team development and the future direction of the practice.
 
This is a role for someone seeking more than management. It's an opportunity to influence strategy, lead clinical excellence and leave a lasting impact on the practice and the wider equine community.
 

Practice Highlights

 
* The only equine-exclusive practice in the Scottish Highlands
* A genuinely hands-on leadership role within a close-knit, experienced team
* Diverse ambulatory and emergency equine caseload
* Opportunity to shape clinical standards, service development and future investment
* Culture built on trust, autonomy and clinical excellence
* Flexible balance of leadership and clinical responsibilities
* Outstanding lifestyle location with access to mountains, coastline and outdoor living
 

How You'll Make a Difference

 
As Clinical Director (Director of Practice & Clinical Services), you will lead the clinical and strategic direction of the practice, working closely with the Practice Manager to deliver outstanding patient care, develop a high-performing team and support sustainable practice growth.
 
You'll play a highly visible leadership role, helping shape the future of the practice while maintaining an active clinical caseload aligned with your interests and expertise.
 

Working Pattern

* Up to 40 hours per week
* 1 in 4.5 out-of-hours weekends
 

Key Responsibilities

* Lead clinical governance, standards and decision-making across the practice
* Develop clinical protocols, patient pathways and quality improvement initiatives
* Mentor and support a small, highly engaged veterinary team
* Work collaboratively on operational performance, workforce planning and long-term sustainability
* Drive service development, investment priorities and strategic growth
* Act as a senior clinical ambassador for clients and referring practices
* Maintain an active clinical caseload aligned with your interests and strengths
* Participate in the shared out-of-hours rota
 

Lifestyle & Location

 
Based in Inverness, the gateway to the Scottish Highlands, this role offers a rare combination of senior clinical leadership and an exceptional quality of life.
 
If you value space, spectacular landscapes and outdoor living alongside a rewarding veterinary career, this is a unique opportunity to enjoy both.
 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 
You are a senior clinical leader with strong equine expertise, commercial awareness and a passion for developing people and services. You'll bring:
 
* Significant experience as an Equine Veterinary Surgeon, ideally with advanced qualifications such as CertAVP or equivalent
* Proven leadership experience with responsibility for supporting and developing veterinary teams
* Strong commercial and financial awareness with an interest in practice performance and sustainability
* The ability to engage, motivate and develop high-performing teams
* Experience contributing to clinical governance, audit and continuous improvement initiatives
* Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills
* A collaborative, values-led leadership style with a commitment to exceptional patient and client care

* A senior leadership position with genuine autonomy and influence over the future direction of the practice
